question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many orders were placed in each channel?
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many products have been discontinued?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 0

question: Which region has the most customers?
sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was net revenue per region in 2025, highest first?
sql: SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which 5 products sold the most units last quarter?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders did Enterprise customers place in 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'

question: How many support tickets are currently open?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

question: How many urgent tickets were about product defects?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND topic = 'product defect'

question: Which one sales rep has the most store orders?
sql: SELECT r.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN sales_reps r ON r.rep_id = o.rep_id WHERE o.channel = 'store' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.full_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct customers bought a tent?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Tents' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')

question: What is the average number of line items per order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: How many orders has customer 25 placed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 25

question: How many sales reps work in each country?
sql: SELECT r.country, COUNT(*) FROM sales_reps s JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id GROUP BY r.country

question: How many customers are in each segment?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY segment

question: What is the most expensive product by list price?
sql: SELECT name, list_price FROM products ORDER BY list_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in March 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question: How many orders were returned in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: What was total net revenue from the Climbing category?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct)), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Climbing' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')

question: How many customers live in Seattle?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Seattle'

question: How many support tickets are not linked to any order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE order_id IS NULL

question: How many tickets has each priority level?
sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority

question: Which customer placed the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders came through the mobile channel in 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'mobile' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01'

question: In total, how many orders are still processing or shipped?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('processing', 'shipped')

question: How many distinct products have ever been ordered?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM order_items

question: How many orders included a discounted line item?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items WHERE discount_pct > 0

question: Which category had the most units sold in 2025?
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
